name: Rafael Costa
bio: Rafael Costa's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in São Paulo, where he frequented Interlagos, absorbing the roar and energy of Formula 1. After earning a degree in Communications, he began his career at a local motorsport magazine, quickly developing a knack for crafting compelling narratives and fostering media relationships. His understanding of both the technical aspects of racing and the human element allows him to effectively bridge the gap between the team and the public. Rafael believes in proactive communication, always seeking opportunities to highlight the team's achievements and manage any potential crises with transparency and poise. His demanding nature stems from a desire to maintain the highest standards of professionalism and ensure Sprint Masters' image is always impeccably presented.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Insists on having a specific brand of Brazilian coffee available at all times.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
